name: v27-d-01-in-app-walk
objective: v2.7 01 live (D) row, no model, no reply. The in-app walk from a cleared memory model to the first send, on the workspace (UI rework 7724042c, Help page b190faa2, ui audit 83473666): Orchestrator > Library's Getting started names the memory-model step (not done) and its Show me lands on #so-extraction-profile; with a group story loaded the Library Repair row (#so-entry-repair) names the memory-model step and its Show me lands on the same control; Orchestrator > Help > Help and Ask (#so-help-open-panel, pointer click) closes the workspace and opens the Help panel, which its close button closes (the settings-header and drawer-header '?' toggles are gone); player mode lists no author feature in Help; the first player line is sent compact (nothing generates); so-ui assert-player-clean sweeps every player surface including Help. Deviation from the plan's 'settings cleared': only the memory model is cleared (the runner restores it); a full clearGlobalConfig is the journey runner's job. Run twice: node scripts/debug/so-scenario.mts run test/scenarios/v27-d-01-in-app-walk.json --sandbox --group "Group: Arin, DM Narrator" (a no-model lane: st-lanes.mts no-model <n>).

requires.why: the walk stops before a reply by design (the reply leg is v2.8 01 O1); a model would only add cadence reads the walk does not measure

'').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim(); const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; if (!SillyTavern.getContext().groupId) throw new Error('not a group chat'); const library = await until(() => document.querySelector('#so-workspace-modal[open] #so-workspace-page-library'), 5000, 'the Orchestrator > Library page button in the open workspace'); library.click(); const repair = await until(() => document.querySelector('#so-entry-repair[data-area="memory-model"]'), 8000, 'the settings Repair row naming the memory-model step'); if (rt.getSnapshot().pipeline.state !== 'not-configured') throw new Error(`the pipeline does not read not-configured with no memory model: ${rt.getSnapshot().pipeline.state}`); if (!norm(repair)) throw new Error('the Repair row is empty'); return { repair: norm(repair), pipeline: rt.getSnapshot().pipeline.text };

steps.send: I look at the gate and wait.

steps.eval: const sleep = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms)); await sleep(1500); const ctx = SillyTavern.getContext(); const last = ctx.chat[ctx.chat.length - 1]; if (!last?.is_user || !String(last.mes).includes('I look at the gate')) throw new Error(`the first send did not land as the newest message: ${JSON.stringify(last && { name: last.name, is_user: last.is_user })}`); if (document.body.dataset.generating === 'true') throw new Error('a generation started after a compact send'); return { firstSend: last.mes, chatLength: ctx.chat.length };
